method: Unchanged BlockChest (ajx), BlockEnderChest (akv), TileEntityChest (aow), TileEntityEnderChest (ape) and InventoryEnderChest (aav) run in the RedstoneProbe World/Chunk fixture. Records: facts (hardness, resistance, light, opacity, drops, silk, bounds), pair (random placements/covers: metadata, pairing, opened inventory), power (viewer counts 0..17), ender (opening refusal per cover), enderNbt (inventory round trips), lid (tile updateEntity steps and sounds), display (portal particle arguments).
